VBO:0200590.summary: Bright, active and confident, the Klein German Spitz often brings a cheerful, steady manner to close companionship. It shares the German Spitz blend of independence and devotion to familiar people. This small size variety was long established in Central Europe before spreading across the continent.
VBO:0200590.shortDescription: Cheerful and alert, the Klein German Spitz combines an independent streak with strong devotion to familiar people.

sources.title: Verein für Deutsche Spitze: Klein breed portrait
sources.evidence: Exact Klein/Miniature breed portrait identifies24–30cm category distinct from Toy/Pomeranian, long presence in CentralEurope then throughout Europe; initially classic colours, now other/particolours.

sources.title: Royal Kennel Club: German Spitz (Klein) standard
sources.evidence: Characteristics intelligent/active/alert with buoyancy, independence and family devotion; temperament happy/equable/confident. Small erect triangular ears, wedge head, square body, straight harsh doublecoat/frill, high full tail curled from root over back. UK Klein23–29cm and Mittel30–38cm, all colours except merle.

sources.title: Royal Kennel Club: German Spitz (Klein)
sources.evidence: About this breed explicitly names larger Mittel and smaller Klein, same standard divided only by size and most colours/combinations permitted. These are colour-unrestricted size categories, not aliases of one already published colour-scoped record.
